viewport: No viewport meta tag, so the page falls back to a 980px desktop layout and the phone scales the whole thing down.
overflow: The page is wider than the screen at 390px, so content runs off the side on every phone.
tapTargets: Multiple tap targets are under the 44px minimum, making the navigation hard to use by thumb.
lcp: Largest contentful paint is slow enough that most mobile visitors see a blank screen first.
pageWeight: The homepage transfers several megabytes, most of it uncompressed imagery.
heroVideo: An autoplaying hero video downloads before anything useful appears.
https: The HTTPS setup is broken or absent, which browsers surface as a warning to every visitor.
mixedContent: Assets load over plain HTTP on an HTTPS page, which downgrades the padlock.
brokenImages: Images on the homepage fail to load, which reads as an abandoned site.
jquery: jQuery predates version 3, dating the build to roughly 2016 or earlier.
bootstrap: Bootstrap 3 or earlier, a framework generation that predates mobile-first defaults.
slider: The hero uses a slider library whose era is unmistakable to anyone who looks.
redesigned: Archive snapshots show no visual change since the site was first built.
copyright: The footer copyright year is several years stale, which visitors read as neglect.
generator: The CMS version stopped receiving security patches years ago.
whatsapp: No WhatsApp contact, despite it being how local enquiries actually arrive.
quoteForm: No working enquiry form, so interested visitors have no low-friction way to make contact.
blog: The blog stopped being updated years ago, which dates the whole site.
domainAge: The domain is new enough that no budget has ever been spent on this site.
